summary: Firefox expanded and refined browser-platform behavior across speculation rules, scrolling, focus, selection, popovers, custom elements, and document loading. Speculation rules can now track and prefetch likely links on hover, while scroll events, visual viewport updates, and range editing more closely follow web standards. The DOM also gained ML-KEM support in WebCrypto, improved Web Speech diagnostics and permissions handling, stronger PDF and frame fallbacks, and updated Permissions-Policy parsing.
